scripts.db:reset: docker compose down --volumes && docker compose up --detach --wait db
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql --username financas --dbname financas
scripts.check:contract: pnpm --filter @financas/api-types lint:spec && pnpm generate:api && (git diff --quiet -- packages/api-types/src/generated && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- packages/api-types/src/generated)" || (echo 'Generated API code is stale: commit the regenerated packages/api-types/src/generated' && exit 1))
scripts.check:icons: pnpm generate:icons && (git diff --quiet -- apps/web/src/kit/icons/generated && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- apps/web/src/kit/icons/generated)" || (echo 'Icon registry is stale: commit the regenerated apps/web/src/kit/icons/generated' && exit 1))
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:contract && pnpm check:icons && pnpm test:coverage
